facts.label: Academia
facts.sub: Nos EUA, academia é gym ou fitness center. Muitas funcionam o dia todo, algumas 24 horas. Você assina um contrato mensal e usa uma pulseira ou cartão para entrar.

pages.title: A new member · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a hot Sunday afternoon in Phoenix, and the gym is quiet. Omar wants to exercise more, so he walks into Fit Zone. He sees many treadmills and some weights in the big room. A woman named Jess sits at the front desk. She has a clipboard with a paper form on it. Omar says hello, and Jess smiles at him.
“Welcome to Fit Zone! Are you here to join?” says Jess. “Yes. Do I fill out a form?” says Omar. “Yes. Write your name, zip code and birthday on the clipboard.” says Jess.
